answers.core: Since gdscript plugins cannot currently add animation nodes that are automatically exposed to the editor "Add Node" submenu.
answers.workaround:
This cannot currently be done with script or c++ modules alone due to the way the animation nodes are exposed to the animation node tree editor.

A much bigger (but also relevant) task here would be to allow for gdscript plugins and c++ submodules to add any arbitrary subclass of AnimationNode and have that automatically be exposed to the editor for addition / removal of the custom node.

title: AnimationTree: Animation Phase Node (and a discussion on custom animation nodes as modules / gdscript)
